row.title: Pages needs an admin credential our automation lacks; ship GitHub-only front ends as Workers
row.body: The administration App answers 403 on /repos/*/pages, LANE_APP and LANE_PAT are unbound. A GitHub-only system's front end ships through the platform's own Worker deploy: topology row plus D1 store, built from the system's own repo.

title: Pages needs an admin credential our automation lacks; ship GitHub-only front ends as Workers
